percentOpenExpectedSensor.description:
The {@link ExpectedSensor} corresponding to the percent open {@link Sensor} instrumented on a control valve.
This sensor measures how much the valve is open, typically represented as a percentage.

processVariableExpectedSensor.description:
The {@link ExpectedSensor} corresponding to the process variable {@link Sensor} instrumented on a control valve.
This sensor measures the process variable (e.g., pressure, temperature) that the valve is controlling.

setpointExpectedSensor.description:
The {@link ExpectedSensor} corresponding to the setpoint {@link Sensor} instrumented on a control valve.
This sensor measures the setpoint value that the control system is trying to maintain for the process.

modeExpectedSensor.description:
The {@link ExpectedSensor} corresponding to the mode {@link Sensor} instrumented on a control valve.
This sensor tracks the mode of the control valve (e.g., manual, automatic).

targetExpectedSensors.description:
A list of {@link ExpectedSensor}s that can be modeled on a control valve {@link ReliabilityAsset}.
This list specifies the sensors that will be used for modeling the valve's behavior or performance.
The sensors selected here are crucial to the machine learning model that will be trained on the data from
these sensors.

excludedExpectedSensorsFromDataPrep.description:
A list of {@link ExpectedSensor}s to exclude from data preparation, specifically for correlation jobs
where data preparation happens automatically with model configuration.
This is useful when certain sensors (e.g., mode) should not be considered for correlation analysis or
should be excluded from the automatic data processing pipeline.

title:
Represents the configuration for setting up a model that works with control valves.
The configuration specifies various sensor types associated with control valves,
such as sensors for the valve's percent open, process variable, setpoint, and mode. It also includes lists
of sensors that should be modeled or excluded from specific tasks like dataset preparation for correlation jobs.

This type is typically used to define how control valve data should be processed and integrated into machine
learning models aimed at predicting or analyzing control valve behaviors and performance.
name: ReliabilityMlControlValvesConfig
